metadata.description: Everything I have built for Claude Code: skills, commands, agents, and packaged tools, in one place.

plugins.name: fig

plugins.name: web-animation-engine
plugins.description: Animated scenes and explainers: a skill plus a React/SVG runtime.

plugins.name: principles-first
plugins.description: First-principles and design-thinking checks for product and architecture decisions.

plugins.name: dev-agents
plugins.description: A ten-agent dev squad (architect, frontend, backend, devops, tester, reviewer and more) plus a browser-test command.

plugins.name: multirepo-git
plugins.description: Branch and merge across multiple sub-repos with two commands: isolate and merge.

plugins.name: spring-clean
plugins.description: Repo housekeeping as a disciplined workflow: measure, delete or gitignore what does not belong, relocate dev docs and notes to a <project>-workspace repo, split oversized files, draw package boundaries, and leave architecture tests so the mess never comes back.

plugins.name: portal-skills
plugins.description: Platform engineering and security skills: GitLab CI/CD + Helm chart generation for Kubernetes, data-driven pod rightsizing from Prometheus, a proactive secure-coding baseline, and a deep OWASP reference (Top 10:2025, LLM Top 10, Agentic AI).

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Bilingual English and Persian TL;DR summaries, written for product managers.

plugins.name: readable
plugins.description: Replies as styled cards (Persian/RTL always, English by default) via a bundled MCP Apps card server: content-only output, template-side styling. Cards can render straight from *-card.html files written by background workers (htmlFile mode). Per-project brand layer (.readable/) reskins cards and reports. Plus report export and a visualize skill.

plugins.name: getpix
plugins.description: Find free licensed images from five sources (Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash, Openverse, Wikimedia), show them right in the chat, or insert optimized WebP with alt text and attribution. Includes photo-pass: a whole-site art-direction pass.

plugins.name: cursor-delegate
plugins.description: Delegate to the Cursor CLI (cursor-agent) from inside Claude Code, on the Cursor subscription's quota instead of Claude's. One task via the cursor-delegate skill, or a parallel fleet via cursor-orchestrate (Claude plans and reviews, Cursor executes). Workers run fully trusted (no approval prompts). Long tasks run legged: ~4-minute legs resumed on one session, immune to flaky-network/VPN stream kills, and the fleet runner auto-resumes unfinished tasks. Key-based deterministic auth, self-terminating runs, resume-first recovery so no work is lost. Workers can author their own report cards that render as chat widgets via the readable plugin (htmlFile mode) at near-zero context cost. Agent calling, not a model-backend swap.

plugins.name: cursor-copy-writing-fa
plugins.description: Persian web copy (blog articles, product descriptions, landing pages, microcopy, SEO meta) written by Cursor workers on the Cursor subscription's quota, with Claude holding the brief and the acceptance gate. Model routing is measured, not guessed: a seven-model bake-off showed Opus 5 writes the best Persian prose, GPT-5.6 Sol is the sharpest proofreader, and free auto is fine for bulk drafts, so each stage goes to the model that won it. Ships fa-lint, a dependency-free Persian copy linter that enforces ZWNJ, Persian punctuation and digits, administrative words, ad clichés and voice as a real exit code. Also measures whether copy reads human: sentence-rhythm variation, repeated openers, repeated phrases and empty closing sentences, with thresholds calibrated against a real human-written corpus. Voice is treated as per-project, never universal: a --voice flag switches the address-form check between informal and formal, mixing the two is flagged either way, and the skill states that a project's own BRAND.md or voice-tone.md outranks the plugin's rulebook.

plugins.name: daily-tools
plugins.description: Everyday Persian-first helpers: four-phase swarm QA campaigns (swarm-qa), copy-ready prompt writing (mkprompt), light multi-agent research (mini-research), plain-language step-by-step guides (steps), and ultra-terse resume-and-continue (go).

plugins.name: decode
plugins.description: A senior-style narrated tour of any codebase for PMs who don't read code: a two-minute story, a VS Code-like browsable file tree, clean per-file canvases weighted by importance, small software-engineering lessons, and diff/PR translation in product language. Persian-first.

plugins.name: backlog-md
plugins.description: Backlog.md task management as a plugin: MCP server, hooks, and a docs-migration skill.

plugins.name: gstack
plugins.description: Garry Tan's gstack dev workflow (53+ skills) packaged for Claude Code. Not our work: all credit to Garry Tan.

plugins.name: gstack-installer
plugins.description: Installs Garry Tan's gstack natively from upstream: clones the repo and runs its real ./setup build (browse binary, 60+ bin tools), always current. Alternative to the gstack snapshot plugin.
